# ACCESSIBILITY_RESULTS.md

**Purpose:** the machine-checkable half of T-135, run against the live application.
**Generated by:** `node tools/a11y/axe_scan.mjs`
**Last run:** 2026-08-29

Generated file. Every number here came from a run against the application serving real API responses, not from a static render.

---

## 1. Result

axe-core reports no serious or critical violation on any view at any context. 9 view and context combinations were checked against wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa.

## 4. What this run does not cover

Two checks in ACCESSIBILITY.md Section 9 need a person and are recorded as not done rather than inferred from the numbers above.

- **Screen reader pass.** NVDA on Windows and VoiceOver on macOS, by a person listening. Automated rules confirm the semantics an assistive technology reads from; they cannot confirm that what it announces makes sense in order.
- **3 metre legibility.** The smallest rendered text is reported per context above, which is the measurable half. Whether it is readable at 3 m on a 55-inch panel needs the panel and the 3 m.
